title: Multiplication, Division, and Remainder with Variables
description: Compute total slices, slices per person, and leftover slices using *, /, and %.

steps.description: Set pizzas = 3, multiply pizzas * 8 to store 24 in slices, and set people = 6.
Divide slices / people to compute each, and use the modulus operator slices % people to compute the remainder leftover.

steps.question: When slices is 24 and people is 6, what values do slices / people and slices % people produce?
steps.answer: Division with / produces the floating-point number 4.0, and 24 % 6 produces the remainder 0.

steps.description: Print slices, each, and leftover on lines 6 through 8.
Inspect slices (24), each (4.0), and leftover (0) in the environment before printing them.
